tables.name: boards
tables.label: Boards
tables.description: The file unit: a workboard of screens, each a real layout that re-solves as you drop widgets.

tables.name: screens
tables.label: Screens
tables.description: One device frame on the board (phone/tablet/web); holds the widgets that make up its layout.

tables.name: widgets
tables.label: Widgets
tables.description: A widget dropped into a screen's top/body/bottom/overlay region; the layout solves around it.

tables.name: flows
tables.label: Flows
tables.description: A navigation link from a widget to a target screen; play mode animates along these.

tables.name: stickies
tables.label: Notes
tables.description: A sticky note floating on a board's canvas, not tied to any one frame.

tables.name: pins
tables.label: Pins
tables.description: A numbered note attached to a specific spot on a frame, left during design review.

tables.name: frameImages
tables.label: Frame images
tables.description: A captured image standing in for a frame's content (a mockup made outside Moku).

tables.name: frameHistory
tables.label: Frame history
tables.description: A frame's earlier version, kept when a proposed revision of it was approved.

tables.name: proposals
tables.label: Proposals
tables.description: A scenario filed as a proposal to change the real app its main board mirrors: a snapshot of the change list, a note and a status.

tables.name: sketchBoxes
tables.label: Sketch boxes
tables.description: A shape drawn on a Sketch artboard (the canvas drawing a sketch frame holds instead of widget blocks).

tables.name: sketchLinks
tables.label: Sketch connectors
tables.description: A connector drawn between two shapes on a Sketch artboard.

tables.name: sketchInk
tables.label: Sketch ink
tables.description: The freehand strokes and handwritten notes on one Sketch artboard.

tables.name: proposalApplies
tables.label: Applied changes
tables.description: One in-app Apply of a proposal's Ready-to-apply changes to your own copy of the app: what changed (before → after), when and by whom — with its Revert. Owner-only, never shared.

tables.name: modelTables
tables.label: Model tables
tables.description: A scenario's own data tables, authored by hand in Moku's Data panel; never touches a real app's data.

tables.name: modelColumns
tables.label: Model columns
tables.description: The typed columns of a scenario's model tables.

tables.name: modelRows
tables.label: Model sample rows
tables.description: Optional sample rows for a scenario's model tables, used to preview and to seed a made app.

tables.name: cobuildSessions
tables.label: Build-with-Claude sessions
tables.description: One Build-with-Claude exchange on a board: when, what you asked, which model. Owner-only recipe history; the API key is never stored here.

tables.name: cobuildSteps
tables.label: Build-with-Claude steps
tables.description: The ordered steps of a Build-with-Claude exchange (what was done or refused, and which frames it touched), replayed as the walk-through.
